name: Farih Muhammad
aboutMarkdown:
Hi, I’m Farih — a Front End Engineer who builds reliable, user-focused products across web, mobile, and interactive applications.  
  
I started my professional journey in 2016 as a Web Front End developer and have since contributed to a wide range of projects, from polished marketing sites to complex web apps and mobile experiences. I’m comfortable owning features end-to-end: translating requirements into clean UI, writing maintainable code, and collaborating closely with designers, backend engineers, and QA to ship with confidence.  
  
I’m passionate about technology and science, and I enjoy learning new tools and patterns that improve both product quality and developer workflow. I’m driven to keep growing, take on meaningful challenges, and deliver solutions that make a real impact.

skills.name: Frontend Engineering
skills.summary: Build scalable web apps with **Next.js**, **React**, **TypeScript**, and **Redux Toolkit** (routing, SSR/CSR, state management, performance).

skills.name: Web Fundamentals & UI
skills.summary: Strong foundation in **HTML/CSS/JavaScript** and practical UI work with **Tailwind CSS**, **PostCSS**, **Bootstrap**, and **jQuery**.

skills.name: Authentication (Azure AD)
skills.summary: Integrate secure sign-in and token flows using **MSAL** (msal-browser / msal-react) and app-level authorization patterns.

skills.name: Real-time Features
skills.summary: Build responsive experiences using **Socket.IO** and server-sent events (SSE) for streaming updates.

skills.name: Testing & Code Quality
skills.summary: Ship reliable features with **Vitest**, **Testing Library**, **ESLint**, and **SonarQube** quality gates.

skills.name: Git & Delivery Workflow
skills.summary: Work comfortably with **Git** on GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, including branching workflows and CI/CD basics.

skills.name: React Native
skills.summary: Deliver cross-platform mobile apps using **React Native**, with experience debugging native issues when needed.

skills.name: Unity Game Engine
skills.summary: Build games and interactive experiences with **Unity** and **C#**, including AR projects.

skills.name: Design Tools
skills.summary: Comfortable working with design assets using **Inkscape**, **Adobe Illustrator**, and basic **Photoshop**.

experiences.summary: AppFuxion Consulting provides digital solutions and software testing services for clients across the Asia-Pacific region.
responsibilities: Build and maintain production web applications using modern React/Next.js and TypeScript patterns.
Integrate authentication and secure session flows using Azure AD (MSAL).
Implement real-time user experiences and data streaming where needed.
Collaborate closely with QA and cross-functional teams to deliver features with quality and predictable timelines.
Improve developer workflow through linting, automated checks, and delivery tooling.

experiences.summary: Creatella is known for building startup products from zero to launch with small, fast-moving teams.
responsibilities: Develop and ship user-facing features for web and mobile applications.
Translate product requirements into clean UI, reusable components, and maintainable code.
Work closely with designers and backend engineers to deliver consistent UX and API integrations.
Write tests and perform regression checks to keep releases stable.

experiences.summary: Plexus Studio delivers interactive products across games, web, mobile, AR, and VR.
responsibilities: Build and maintain front-end features across web and mobile projects, including interactive experiences.
Integrate APIs and ensure responsive, accessible UI across devices and browsers.
Collaborate with designers and the wider engineering team to deliver on time and with quality.
Continuously learn and apply new tools and patterns to improve development efficiency.

experiences.summary: Software development company delivering business applications for local clients.
responsibilities: Build front-end modules for a school lab management system.
Implement CRUD screens, form validation, and dashboard-style UI components.
Maintain and improve existing features through bug fixes and iterative enhancements.

experiences.summary: Freelance developer delivering web and mobile solutions for clients.
responsibilities: Deliver web and mobile projects from requirements to implementation.
Integrate third-party APIs and troubleshoot cross-browser or device-specific issues.
Provide maintenance, bug fixes, and improvements based on client feedback.
